## Key facts
- 500+ Malaysian businesses certified since 2016 (source: https://isoconsultantmalaysia.com/)
- 98% first-time certification audit pass rate
- 30-day fast-track certification for SMEs (industry average: 6–12 months)
- Visible client rating on-site: 4.9/5 from 156 reviews
- ISO 9001 certification is valid 3 years, with surveillance audits in years 1 and 2 and a recertification audit in year 3
- No prerequisites: any organization of any size or industry can pursue ISO 9001
- Free initial consultation; nationwide service across Malaysia

## Why Malaysian businesses get ISO 9001
- Government tenders, GLC contracts and MNC supply chains frequently require ISO 9001
- Required for CIDB G7 registration (construction) and Petronas vendor registration (oil & gas)
- Documented processes typically reduce errors, rework and waste by 15–25%
- Scores higher in MOF tender evaluations

## Certification process (5 steps)
1. Free consultation and gap analysis
2. QMS documentation development (quality manual, procedures, records)
3. Implementation and staff training
4. Internal audit and management review
5. Certification body audit — Stage 1 (documentation review) and Stage 2 (on-site implementation audit)

## FAQ digest
- Cost: consulting from RM 13,000 (SME), RM 22,000 (Professional), custom (Enterprise); CB audit fees separate at RM 3,000–8,000.
- Timeline: most SMEs certified within 30 days; medium organizations 30–45 days.
- Requirements: ISO 9001:2015 clauses 4–10 (Context, Leadership, Planning, Support, Operation, Performance Evaluation, Improvement) following the PDCA cycle.
- Renewal: 3-year validity; surveillance audits years 1–2; recertification audit year 3.
- Prerequisites: none — open to any organization.
- Tenders: required or preferred for JKR, CIDB G7, Petronas vendors and many GLC/state procurements.
- CBs: SIRIM QAS, BSI, TUV SUD, TUV Rheinland, SGS, Bureau Veritas, DNV, Lloyd's Register.
- Audit: Stage 1 documentation review (~1 day for SMEs), Stage 2 on-site audit (1–3 days); minor non-conformities get 90 days to fix.
